headline: Dominican Republic Breaks Ground on $2.38 Billion Yanuna Tourism Project
summary: President Luis Abinader is leading the groundbreaking ceremony for the Yanuna mega-tourism project in Macao, Punta Cana, which is projected to draw $2.375 billion in investments.
why: Large-scale tourism infrastructure investments drive construction activity, foreign direct investment, and employment growth in the Dominican Republic's hospitality sector.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: Multi-billion dollar tourism development boosts capital inflows and construction sector activity.
